Noah was seen in the Children's Emergency Department on 26 September 2026. He had a temperature of 38.5°C. He has a viral infection (a germ called a virus). Noah does not need antibiotics. He was drinking well and playing when he left the department.

## What you need to do
1. See your GP (family doctor) if Noah is not better in 5 days.
2. Do not ask for antibiotics. Noah does not need them.

## Dates and medicines

- Antibiotics are not needed.

- How will I know if Noah is getting better?

- Who should I call if I have worries about Noah?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.
